Create Model Weights tables

create_model_weights_tables.Rd

Displays the model weights, constant, Null log-likelihood and estimated model log-likelihood and adjusted rho-squared of the different models. Saves the table as data/tables/model_weights_<group>.html using the gt package.

Usage

create_model_weights_tables()

Value

gt table of last model

Examples

create_model_weights_tables()
